随着主人公逐渐失去控制，他们的朋友和家人只能惊恐地看着。这部剧集的悲剧结局被视为对我们计划向机器身体过渡的一种毫不掩饰的批评。

texts.en:
A massively popular new drama has captivated the public imagination. The story centers on a synthetic worker who disassociates from their new body.

As the protagonist spirals out of control, their friends and family can only look on in horror. The drama's tragic ending is being viewed as a thinly veiled criticism of our planned transition to machine bodies.

Public discourse around the smash hit has generated considerable pushback, and may ultimately slow our progress.
